status.en: 13 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 24% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 13 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 24 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iraq has shut the Sheeb border crossing with Iran to check security, while Iranian and Iraqi officials discuss expelling Kurdish opposition groups from the border area, a claim Iraq publicly denies. Turkish forces remain deployed in Syria and Iraq until border security is assured, and Iraqi troops have been redeployed between Kirkuk and Baghdad amid IS plans to increase attacks in fragile regions. An IRGC officer was killed in the Iran-Iraq border mountains during clashes with Kurdish opposition, and Iraq has threatened a crackdown on opponents of its weapons-control and disarmament plan. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irak har stengt Sheeb-grenseovergangen mot Iran for å sjekke sikkerheten, mens iranske og irakiske tjenestemenn diskuterer å utvise kurdiske opposisjonsgrupper fra grenseområdet, en påstand Irak offentlig benekter. Tyrkiske styrker er fortsatt utplassert i Syria og Irak inntil grensesikkerheten er sikret, og irakiske soldater er omplassert mellom Kirkuk og Bagdad etter at IS planlegger å øke angrep i skjøre regioner. En IRGC-offiser ble drept i fjellene på Iran-Irak-grensen under sammenstøt med kurdisk opposisjon, og Irak har truet med en nedslag på motstandere av sin våpenkontroll‑ og avrustningsplan. Konflikten registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
